# NoC_EventRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network-on-chip design that routes event-based spikes from event cameras to SNN cores with minimal latency and congestion. Ensures scalable, high-throughput communication for distributed neuromorphic processors, a core requirement for TCC-based systems.
